headline: Mac compute-rental firm warns of falling AI inference payouts
summary: Darkbloom, a firm that lets Mac users rent out their idle compute and GPUs for AI inference workloads, has warned of low and plummeting payouts as token prices keep dropping. One report says Anthropic's token price fell 77 percent in under five months, squeezing the revenue users earn for sharing their compute.

claims.statement: Darkbloom warned that payouts for Mac users renting out compute for AI inference are falling as token prices drop.
